QuestInfo.name: Bruce's Dilemma
QuestInfo.0: It seems like #p206#, your neighbor living in #m10001000#, has something on his mind.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p206##k, your neighbor living in #b#m10001000##k, has been agonizing over how to get his newly found daughter, #b#p506##k, to open her heart to him. It might be best to seek advice from #b#p203##k. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 17 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I met with #p203# to find a way for #p206#, my neighbor living in #m10001000#, to become closer and open up with his daughter, #p506#.

0.0: I cannot begin to tell you how overjoyed I am to have found my daughter, whom I thought was lost forever, all thanks to you. I want to express my deepest gratitude once more. However, though I have finally reunited with my precious family, another dilemma has arisen. Since you are a neighbor living here in #m10001000#, I feel I can trust you with this... Would you mind lending an ear to my story?

yes.0: Thank you! To be honest, perhaps because #p506# grew up so much while we were apart, she has not yet opened her heart to me. She seems glad to have found her father again, but somehow, it feels like there are things she cannot bring herself to tell me. I want to act like a proper father to her now, but I simply do not know where to begin.
yes.1: Ah, that's it! When it comes to matters like this, it might be best to seek advice from #b#p203##k. Please, I beg of you to go and ask for her counsel.

no.0: You must be busy at the moment. But as they say, a close neighbor is better than a distant friend. If you can spare some time later, I would truly appreciate it if you could listen to my story.

1.0: Oh my, if it isn't #h0#, a resident of our village! What brings you to see me today? Wait, what? You say #p206# is looking for a way to get closer to #p506#?

npc.0: I am deeply worried about how I can grow closer to my daughter, #p506#, whom I have only just found. Won't you please go to #p203# here in town and ask for her advice?
